title: Conjugated untwisted diagonal comparison
statement: For the rational projective-line square, the diagonal pullback of the inverse ambient square comparison equals the second pull-section identification followed by the inverse of the first pull-section identification.

source.place: Second identity, first factor before the Tate twist.

proof.text: Expand the ambient square comparison into normalized inverse-image compositors. Restrict along the diagonal, use diagonal followed by each projection equal to the identity, and cancel the identity compositor.

proof_origin.place: Second identity, first factor before the Tate twist.

lean.statement: theorem second_pull_section_core_conjugate (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l)) (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l) (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] (K : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X Y)) : (moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (diagonalImmersion Y)).map ((ambientPullbackComparison (coefficient l c).X (square Y)).symm.app K).inv = (pullSectionIso (coefficient l c).X Y (secondProjection Y) (by unfold secondProjection; exact pullback.diagonal_snd _)).hom.app ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj K) ≫ (pullSectionIso (coefficient l c).X Y (firstProjection Y) (by unfold firstProjection; exact pullback.diagonal_fst _)).inv.app ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj K)
